reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for physician administered services when appropriately reported. 
Appropriate reporting includes 
• 
Reporting only up to the unit limits set by HFS for CPT and/ or HCPCS codes. 
• 
For drugs that are not administered and are discarded, the HCPCS code must be reported 
with the JW modifier. Discarded units billed with the JW modifier are excluded from unit 
limits. 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
CPT and/ or HCPCS codes are reported with units that exceed the unit limits set by HFS 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT/ HCPCS code(s), 
modifiers and ICD-10-CM codes reported.
